title: SDK revocation handling
acceptance: List signature is verified with its kid; lower versions are rejected
Lists older than R_MAX, or missing, are never accepted as current under any profile
Policy hook may define suspend or restrict; the default is deny
findings: Corrections: imported plan denied only under Standard and cached for min(RL_INTERVAL, R_MAX). The spec denies under every profile, and worst-case latency is about RL_INTERVAL plus R_MAX, not the minimum of the two.
